Application Progress

Add Account

Application Process

Complete the Waste Collection Form to register your property for waste management.

  1. Applicant details

    Enter your name, contact number and application date.

  2. Collection property

    Add the property name, collection address and billing details.

  3. Service category

    Choose your property type, complete any additional service details and upload your supporting documents.

  4. Preview and confirm

    Review your information and accept the declaration. Sign in or create an account to submit your application.

  5. Follow your application

    After submitting, open My Applications to check council updates and any issued invoice.
